_comment: Title-based targeting rules (lib/targeting.js). Patterns are case-insensitive regex source strings, tested against the role title only. Grades are checked in order; the first match wins. Then: hard exclusions; soft exclusions (skipped when the title also names a technology function); the product-leadership override; the hands-on exclusion; families in order (first match wins). Employers that do not put a bank grade in the title (Visa, Invesco, Mastercard, Barclays for some roles) still have senior lead roles: a product owner / product manager / program manager / engineering, development or delivery manager / engineering lead / chapter, squad or tribe lead title with no grade is a target unless it carries a below-AVP marker (Specialist, Associate, Analyst...). leadership_override: these people-leader titles skip the hands-on exclusion (e.g. 'Chapter Lead - Data Engineer'). Grade tokens use (^|[^a-z]) instead of \b because titles like 'AVP_ Data Products' put an underscore (a regex word character) next to the grade. exclude_support (application/infrastructure support, operations, service desk) excludes a support title unless it is a leader role: it has a support_leader word (manager, head, lead, leader) or a support_leader grade (SVP, Director, Associate Director, Head). User decision 2026-10-13: include engineering leader roles even when they are support roles.

grades.pattern: ^(?!.*\b(specialist|associate|analyst|junior|assistant|intern|trainee|apprentice)\b).*\b(product owner|product manager|program(me)? manager|product (management )?lead(er)?|delivery lead(er)?|manager,? (software )?engineering|engineer(ing)? manager|development manager|delivery manager|engineering lead(er)?|(chapter|squad|tribe) lead(er)?)\b

description_check._comment: Applied to the full job description (when it has 500+ characters). A role is excluded as non-IT when it has 3+ distinct non-IT signals, or 2+ with fewer than 8 IT signals, or fewer than 2 IT signals. User decision 2026-10-13: remove non-IT jobs from all employers.
description_check.non_it_signals: \b(hvac|plumbing|physical plant|refrigeration|substation|hvdc|statcom|power system studies|epc|transmission|insulation coordination|construction management|clinical|cdisc|adam|biostatistic\w*|pharmaceutical selling|hcp|oncologist|field sales|sales quota|credit risk model\w*|pd, lgd|ifrs ?9|stress testing|derivatives pricing|value at risk)\b

amazon.reason: Amazon IC level (Program/Product Manager title without Senior or Principal)

_comment_rules: junior_level_suffix: ungraded titles ending in level I or II are junior (owner decision 2026-10-14). employer_rules: extra exclusions for one employer; Amazon plain PM/TPM titles are IC levels (owner decision 2026-10-14: drop junior levels only, keep Senior/Principal and managers).
_comment_employer_min_fit: employer_min_fit_score: hide a scored role of this employer when its RM fit is below the value (owner decision 2026-10-14: Amazon 65 keeps its most relevant roles). Unscored and stale roles stay.
